items.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks
items.summary: The vulnerabilities posed denial-of-service and validator resource risks but were patched before Polygon publicly disclosed them.

items.title: Chelsea FC gets a stablecoin sponsor after UK FCA warning to clubs
items.summary: According to Circle, the USDC stablecoin name will appear on the front of club jerseys for Chelsea’s upcoming football season.

items.title: Bitcoin eyes $81K as Nvidia earnings beat boosts risk assets
items.summary: Bitcoin and crypto joined US stock markets in fresh gains after Nvidia Q2 earnings beat expectations by around $4 billion.

items.title: Crypto market makers are cashing in on bitcoin's rally - without betting on direction
items.summary: As bitcoin surges back above $80,000, sophisticated trading firms are quietly collecting yield rather than making directional bet.

items.title: Russia’s Sber eyes USDT loans, questions digital ruble demand
items.summary: Russia’s largest bank, Sber, plans to accept USDT and Ether alongside Bitcoin as loan collateral as the country introduces regulated crypto trading under a new law.

items.title: Real Trump Coins denies launching GOLD token, blames ‘bad actors’
items.summary: Trump-linked Real Trump Coins said it never authorized GOLD or any digital token as questions persisted over its X account, associated domains and the concentrated token supply.

items.title: A $1.1 million crypto card hack crashed a neobank's token 49%
items.summary: The exploit caused the neobank's AVICI token to drop 49% from a 24-hour high, hitting a record low before paring some of the losses.

items.title: Ditching 'digital gold': BPI study suggests everyday Americans prefer control and micro-investing
items.summary: A new survey suggests some of bitcoin's most familiar sales pitches of changing the world may be poorly suited to a majority of prospective buyers.

items.title: Inside the high-stakes battle between digital dollars and Swift's massive money engine
items.summary: Crypto executives say new blockchain payment infrastructure could make Swift obsolete. Bankers say its 11,500-institution network gives it the power to absorb the technology instead.

items.title: The next trillion-dollar currency may not be a stablecoin — it might not even have a name yet
items.summary: AI agents are coming. They will need to pay each other. Crypto executives agree on the problem but disagree sharply on the solution, and one thinks the answer has not been invented yet.

items.title: Tokenized assets are busier than the data shows
items.summary: When you strip out what was never mobile, correct for who's holding what and why, add back what works off-contract, the utilization of tokenized assets looks close to 20%, argues Katana’s Matthew Fisher.

items.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million worth of coins
items.summary: Six decade-old wallets moved $40 million this month, but Galaxy's data shows dormant coin activity at its lowest since 2022 and 2026 on pace for under half of last year's total.

items.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
items.summary: An Anthropic model cut the work needed to break a leading post-quantum signature candidate by a factor of 67 million last month, while Bitcoin and Ethereum published their own migration plans this week.

items.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
items.summary: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.

items.title: Tokenized stock transfer volume jumps 415% in 30 days to $29.5B
items.summary: Tokenized equities saw a sharp rise in onchain activity as active addresses and holders more than doubled over the past month.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Trump-promoted brand touts GOLD before token collapse
items.summary: Real Trump Coins promoted GOLD before deleting related X posts, while team-linked wallets sold 224.5 million tokens as its market value fell about 99%.

items.title: Stablecoins not credible for payments at scale, BIS chief says
items.summary: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos said stablecoins lack credibility for payments at scale, while a new FSI study highlights sharp differences in issuer rules.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs end 9-day inflow streak as BTC dips below $78K
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $201.8 million in net outflows Friday, led by ARK 21Shares, as total fund assets slipped back below $100 billion.

items.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
items.summary: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.
